---
title: "2.10 Conclusion"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

- Do not assume a linear regression **model** is restricted to linear **effects**
- Useful to distinguish between linear and nonlinear effects
  - And between additive and interactive effects
- Linear regression models can produce nonlinear and/or interactive effects
- All models for categorical DVs produce nonlinear and interactive effects
  - Tools for interpretation are largely the same as we covered in this section:
    - Predictions
    - Visualizations
    - Marginal effects
